disclaimer.title: Mental health — our 5th pillar.
disclaimer.intro: Real health is physical AND mental. /mind is your daily mental check-in, your private journal, your sessions library, and your AI coach for the head.
disclaimer.important_body: MakeIt's Mind module is NOT clinical treatment. It's training mental habits — comparable to breathwork, journaling, and reflection. NOT a substitute for therapy or medication. If you're in a bad place, or thinking about harming yourself or others, talk to a real human who can help right now.
disclaimer.resources_doctor: Your doctor or the psychiatric ER
disclaimer.privacy_journal: Your journal is ALWAYS private. Not Munk, not coaches, not other members can read it. Ever.
disclaimer.privacy_mind_check: Your mind-check is private by default. When you tier up, you can choose to share your signal with your buddy. Both must opt in.
disclaimer.privacy_ai: AI coach reads your mind-check, HRV, and training week — never your journal — to write you a daily reflection. Output is stored so you can re-read it.
disclaimer.accepted: Thank you — the module is open.
